newsitem.title: UK: Jose Ignacio Domecq dies aged 82.
newsitem.headline: Jose Ignacio Domecq dies aged 82.

text.p: Jose Ignacio Domecq Gonzalez, known as El Nariz (The Nose) for his skill as a connoisseur of sherries, brandies and other spirits, has died in Jerez, Spain, aged 82, drinks group Allied Domecq said.
"He personified the sherry industry and was a wonderful ambassador for sherry and brandy around the world," said Peter Macfarlane, Chairman of Pedro Domecq SA.
He played an integral part in developing the quality of all Domecq products, the company said.
Domecq will perhaps be best remembered as the figure in the Domecq sherry television advert where he was pictured sampling a sherry's bouquet.
He started his career on January 1, 1940 at the Domecq winery in Jerez, becoming a board director of Pedro Domecq in 1947.
Pedro Domecq, one of the oldest sherry companies in Jerez, was formed in 1730 and acquired by the Domecq family in 1816.

The family expanded its interests into Mexico in 1941 and in 1956 Pedro Domecq Mexico became a subsidiary of Pedro Domecq. Since then further overseas subsidiary companies have been established, including in the U.S., Brazil and Colombia.
